pose_en: Front view. She sits upright on the seat of a small shoulder-rotation machine with a padded lever beside her right side. Her RIGHT upper arm hangs vertically and is pressed TIGHT against the side of her trunk (no gap between arm and body), the elbow bent exactly 90 degrees so the forearm points straight FORWARD toward the viewer, hand around the vertical lever grip in front of her belly. The left hand rests on her thigh. No text or brand name. One curved arrow at the right hand points OUTWARD to her right, showing the forearm rotates outward while the elbow stays at the side.
opmerking: r2 voorbeeldset; alleen bij budget over
